game.title: Days Gone
game.blurb: Action game of motorbikes, survivors and Freaker hordes, from Bend Studio, released 2019-04-26. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough and Gameplay are linked but not written, and only Controls and a short Table of Contents subpage exist. daysgone.fandom.com answers the API, with about 45 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 18 of 67 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Six hidden ones listed at the end of the schema (from "More Freakers, More Problems" to "Sarah's Gift") have very low unlock rates (0.6 to 1.3 percent), and "This is a Knife" (21.6 percent) sits among combat ones, so these are probably not story beats and need checking.
